notes:
Version 1.5.0
- Optional Alpaca PAPER trading (practice money only). Click "Alpaca settings" on the New analysis screen to add your paper keys and test the connection.
- New green "Place Paper Trade" button next to the recommendation: you choose the number of shares each time, see the estimated cost, and pick Market or Limit. Nothing is ordered until you confirm.
- Optional morning auto-sell: every weekday at 9:00 AM New York time it re-analyses what you hold in the paper account and sells anything rated SELL or UNDERWEIGHT. Summary under "Auto-sell log"; "Run auto-sell now (test)" has a dry-run mode.
- Updates and installs are more reliable (they close an open TradingAgents window and retry if a file is locked).
